title: Design and Field Validation of a Multi-Functional Embedded Edge Control Platform for Real-Time Environmental Monitoring and Closed-Loop Control
content: This study presents the design and field validation of a multi-functional embedded edge-control platform for real-time environmental monitoring and closed-loop intelligent control. The proposed system provides a hardware–software infrastructure capable of collecting heterogeneous environmental data, reliably transmitting it, and executing adaptive control actions under outdoor conditions. The embedded control board integrates a microcontroller-based architecture with isolated digital and analogue interfaces, dual serial communication channels, watchdog-based reliability mechanisms, memory units, and remotely adjustable hardware parameters. These features enable stable operation, fault tolerance, and remote supervision within an Internet of Things framework. The proposed architecture provides a reusable hardware infrastructure for AI-enabled autonomous automation systems. The platform was deployed outdoors and operated autonomously for an extended period to evaluate real-world performance. Experimental observations demonstrate reliable communication, stable system behaviour, and adaptive response to environmental variability. The results indicate that the platform functions as a general-purpose intelligent automation node and provides a scalable infrastructure for future AI-assisted environmental control applications.
